Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.x509

Class DevX509KeyStore

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.x509.DevX509KeyStore
public class DevX509KeyStore extends Object
Provides the server certificate of the dedicated TLS port when the dev profile is active and none is configured, so a developer does not have to create one: a self-signed certificate for localhost is generated once per machine with the JDK's keytool, stored in a key store under ~/.irurueta-auth-server/ that only the owner can read (its password in a file next to it, as DevKeyEncryptionSecret keeps its secret) and reused at every start. Nothing is ever written inside the repository.

Why it lives in src/main although it only serves development: the end-to-end tests run the packaged jar with the dev profile, and a class under src/test never reaches it. It is inert everywhere else: the bean exists only under the dev profile, and the port itself is off unless authserver.x509.port is set. The clients' certificates are never validated by the connector (the fingerprint binding is what identifies them), so the key store holds the server's certificate only.
